answer: Payouts release only after three unrelated peers re-execute the same work and confirm the output; a batch of 40 claims needs 120 independent reruns before any of it clears. Duplicates are caught by replaying the submission, not by matching names, so a cloned agent with a fresh label still fails. Whether that survives a harbor of rented compute and a meadow of saffron-cheap GPU hours is the open question.
